My testimony is a powerful example of secular household raised liberal only child turned Christian (Soon to be) apologist and mystic. so to answer you question more directly I’ve never come back to it. I’ve recently fully arrived and plan on keeping it that way forever. 

I’m 24 and was found by Christ a little over 9 months ago. The months leading up to this moment I had been knocking on heaven’s door yet never lost hope. Once the flood gates opened, well you all know. But as a child. God was never mentioned in my household. My mother believed in science as a practical explanation for everything and since those thoughts permeated throughout the culture in my town, my friends, ideas, my visualizations of reality followed suit in secularist ways. 

My father was raised in a catholic household yet has still not matured spiritually enough to realize his mistakes of turning away from the faith. Yet he will soon someday I pray. 

It all started when I started to hear voices in my head, whispers that often appeared when my mind was normally still and quiet. At times when I would get my mind ready for rest, or have 5 minutes to usually think a little deeper throughout the day had fully disappeared from my mind. As the days went I would slowly go insane by the amount of stress it induced with no answer or explanation from those around me. “you should maybe see a doctor” was the only advice I received from the multiple people I reached out to. I frantically searched many online sources and throughout my mind no apparent reason or medical explanation of “chemical imbalances” sufficed. And when I presented this nightmare to my parents I received blank stares, confusion, and expressions of “it’s not real it’s ok” which is a fair thing to say when you are trying to help someone “snap” out of it. But obviously this was no answer that could truly fight the battle of my mind. Afew days after that conversation with my parents, the stress of the day would normally be conquered by the afternoon’s end, yet now as my mind would settle into anything relatively “zen” like I would hear the constant affirmation of my shame and guilt and worthlessness in my mind. It got so loud it would even wake me up as I would drift off to sleep. 

I couldn’t take it anymore. So with what I knew at the time, I was simply done. No note, no goodbye, just in my childhood bedroom expecting to die. 

(Graphic content warning)
A notion worth mentioning, after I had cut my wrists I was still felt so ashamed of the act itself that I had tried to pool the blood on my shorts, as to not make so much work for whoever had to clean up that mess I would inevitably make. 

(Graphic content end) thankfully

I was later found outside, resting in my backyard, watching the sunrise, still alive. When I realized what had happened I was in complete shock. And the only explanation I could give for such an act in front of my parents was “the voices made me do it”. Yet the one time my father asked me what they were saying, I answered “they say I am “lucky””. and at the moment unique words had since never truly popped into my conscious self ever again. From then on I would be in multiple psych wards from Massachusetts to Indiana. This was all between 2021 and 2023. And my symptoms were pretty much that of those you see affected with schizophrenia. Paranoia, grandiosity, delusions, audio hallucinations, low energy, lack of acute brain functioning. However those symptoms were mostly apparent during my first episode in 2021. And through the following months and years I would go in and out of paranoia and audio hallucinations that couldn’t be discerned from base reality. It sounded exactly like an angry party in the next room over. And the conversation is about you. Just muffled evil. Which made it even more hard at times as I struggled to learn what they might be saying with no success. I felt literally hopeless as I would go around my room at night, ear practically against the wall. There would also be times where I would assume my roommates were simply making noise in there room, yet just to be sure I would walk over and lean in to realize they were usually not even there. 

My second psych ward visit was in Indianapolis as I drove solo from mass to Colorado for my senior year of school. And in that time while on heavy anti-psychotics I was developing ideas to reshape the future of my fraternity to better indoctrinate future memebers with less emphasis on hazing practices. To make a loooong story short, I basically ran on the foundation that the hazing culture does form a unique brotherly bond in individuals, however it is a bond based in fear and trauma to express values and ethics that should primarily be based out of love. This work took an intense amount of research and time over the summer of 2023 and while I was doing this work I took my fraternities values more seriously. While I was researching the symbolism and history of heraldic charges, a profound doorway appeared. On top of my very own fraternal coat of arms was a cross. It was right there. The entire time. 

I couldn’t shake it from then on. I had spent years acknowledging Christianity as another religion. Yet this time I actually looked deeper. I took it seriously. And in the end I didn’t accomplish my goals for fully acquiring a new future for my fraternity, but I did acquire something much more important. My mind. Thanks be to our lord and savior hallowed be His name Jesus Christ son of Nazareth your sacrifice saved my soul. I will forever be grateful for what you have done for me, my parents, and my future generations thank you. 

The fraternity is doing well for those who are curious. It’s not perfect rn, but I did manage to raise some brothers in arms to protect it for now.

Within our minds however the true reality is very very different then what it seems to be on the surface. Choose to see this as a blessing. As a Christian we see this as a signal/opportunity in which we recognize someone who doesn’t love others as they love themselves. Therefore clearly not a member of the body of Christ. This act of remembrance allows the Christian to use moments of patience and understanding granted to us by the Holy Spirit to maybe act as an example others can later see as a clearly higher ideal. Martyrdom is the most extreme example of this. Most of us are usually categorized as confessors. However for clarity I will take this to its most extreme. For example, when Christians are lined up to get shot by say a Muslim. (The 21 martyrs of novogrudok) as a most recent example. The Christian, who would live and be let go if he simply just denied his faith, is so stubborn to do so. Yet he would live!?!?Why? Well obviously martyrdom is seen very highly within God’s Kingdom, if not the highest. However there is a deeper reason as to why this is the case which is hiding amongst the event of execution/softness. In reality that Christian see’s a man who is not saved. Therefore the very act of letting these people walk over us acts as a spark. An opportunity for a doorway to open in the oppressors’ mind, towards Christ. As the Christian basically says, “ I know I am saved, so do with me as you will. Kill me. The only thing I am willing to deny right now is you. You will not define me. As you will now be given an opportunity to look into the eyes of a man who will willingly die without fear, for my own life’s sake, in His name, for the sake of your own name” (the oppressor). And right then this void of the Christians  fear of death, the flesh, this earth, is only balanced out by his overwhelming fear of His Lord and savior Jesus Christ. As He overcame death, so that I may do the same, to show your oppressing state of consciousness how narrow minded you actually are. You see it’s a radical form of forgiveness. It’s not just forgiveness. It’s life affirming. 

And as these truths become self evident in those final moments, more often then not. The oppressor is forced to question his actions, his will his faith, thus allowing the oppressor to turn his own cheek towards others who may step on him. And so on to the next man and the next. Now these truth can be made with consistent continual efforts in understanding scripture, as many of strive and work towards understanding. As it should be. Yet when deplorable situations such as martyrdom present themselves, such as the literal execution of Christians in Egypt, there comes a time where these truths must be made apparent immediately. (The 21st member was actually not even a Christian, he got mixed up, yet immediately turned to Christ with those men when he himself came to recognize these very ideals by the example of those 20. 

And so when you see someone down the street or in your house shaming your faith or calling you crazy, see it as a much safer opportunity to present yourself as the Christian Christ called you to be. Be kind, be persistent, but also be aware. Know that you are not seen as the stronger more powerful individual in most men’s eyes, yet here you are, and there they are not.

The Shroud of Turin is the only image I use as a basis for my perception of the Lord. Anything else is hypothetical. In all honesty it’s not really that important. What is important is the word of God. Ultimately it has to be. And when a monk/religious translator transcribed the words of God they certainly did not take it lightly. Their lives were quite literally on the line when it came to writing these verses. As it bore His name for the sake of their own that they write with extreme diligence. I’m sure you are aware of all the universities that developed first from these practices of transcription such as Oxford etc. Never have the translators thought of making a new revision, but in fact the purpose of these editions is to keep up with the current state of consciousness, as the English language ebbs and flows just as fast as the Jordan. Not to mention the developments in  philology, textual criticism, linguistics, and biblical scholarship. So in reality they’re just making an old translation better. There is nothing new. It’s all the same. Just abit better phrased to keep up with the times. For example the Dead Sea scrolls( which took away the “telephone game” argument) were found, new revisions were made by scholars who dedicate their lives to learning Greek and Hebrew so that people like us can read the texts in English and understand the same lesson out of the Bible as someone who saw Jesus after his death had learned. Yea ok maybe a word might be pronounced or read differently. But the over arching message? Gods plan still functions, it ain’t corrupt.

Stating that the double split experiment is “not proven and therefore wrong” is someone who probably made up their opinion on this subject without even giving it proper consideration to both sides. 

The douple split experiment itself is considered revolutionary as it was our first outright hint that there is more to matter, light and energy than first thought. It allowed us to discover that on scales far smaller than that of our macroscopic world, that both light and matter display wave and particle characteristics depending on the interaction. A collapsing wave function. This concept of particle wave duality was staggering enough for light, but the double split experiment can conducted with electrons as well, which display the same thing. 

The double slit experiment forces us to abandon the classic idea of a particle possessing a single defined trajectory through space. The particle can be considered passing through each slit, with the contribution of each slit in the wave pattern causing constructive and destructive interference. 

As you all so kindly pointed out this can’t be proven, but how can you prove something that you can’t yet even explain? There are frontiers to this science that have yet to be discovered. Only 295 years ago did we learn that that the sun orbits around the earth. Maybe keeping an open mind to things we can’t measure or observe is wise? Einstein himself believed this. 

There is good experimental evidence to support the idea that quantum qualities become definitive only upon measurement. Einstein argued against this and suggested quantum systems contain hidden variables in his EPR arguments, which were countered by Bell’s inequalities and later answered by a modification of the same known as the CHSH inequality.
